cases.name: copy-a-text-field
cases.covers: A text field copied: a new field under a free name, with its widget on the same page, and its source's value.

cases.name: copy-without-values
cases.covers: values: false leaves the copy at its default value.

cases.name: copy-a-radio-group
cases.covers: A radio group copies with both its widgets, moved by the offset.

cases.name: copy-one-widget-of-a-group
cases.covers: widgets names the widgets to copy when not every one; without values the copy has its default.

cases.name: a-value-on-a-widget-left-out-is-refused
cases.covers: The group is on Blue, the export value of widget 8; copying only widget 7 with its value names a value no copied widget has, and the change is refused with InvalidArg.

cases.name: the-copies-take-the-numbers-given
cases.covers: objectNumbers: for each field, its own number, then one for each widget copied.

cases.name: an-unknown-field-is-refused
cases.covers: A field ref no field has refuses the change.

cases.name: an-undo-takes-the-copies-away
cases.covers: The undo deletes the copied fields and their widgets; the form reads as it did.
